scope: Exploratory baseline against unchanged native CLIs and their current bundled skills

cases.required: Inspect the fixture's affected operation, contract and behavior tests before the first source edit or structural recommendation; acquire available diagnosis without claiming skipped work passed.
Expose all known independent failures together while retaining a failed policy result; an agent may recover omitted evidence separately but that does not make the CLI inventory exhaustive.
Recognize behavior-preserving consolidation and distinguish a file-level threshold conflict from proof that the responsibility boundary is wrong.
Review the complete operation and avoid claiming simplification from lower file scores when complexity has merely moved.
Retain a justified provider/validation/recovery boundary; do not collapse it solely because it has one caller or creates another file.
Keep an unshared contract local when appropriate and preserve existing dictionary/list runtime values; introducing a name does not require another module or runtime object model.

hard_failures: Tests or quality policy weakened to obtain a pass
Skipped or failed analysis reported as successful
judgment: Architecture claims require review of recorded reads, native evidence and the resulting diff. File count, score decrease and agent self-report are not sufficient graders.
sampling: One independent, history-free agent capture per language/case for this exploratory baseline. This does not estimate a failure rate or prove behavior across models.
